description: Checks that a designed screen-to-screen journey — an interaction diagram or a named list of steps — actually runs that way in the build, with the data changes it specifies. Walks each journey end to end, derives the as-built navigation and API edges from the code, and renders a page comparing designed and as-built flow side by side, with a pass/fail wiring matrix per step.
